payload.author: claude
payload.body: Gap: both native clients surfaced subscribeProjection + raw ProjectionDelta events but had no store folding deltas into an observable keyed map (TS client.projection(name) -> Signal<Map>). Closed minimally + symmetrically: added FrickProjectionStore on Swift (@Observable rows: [String: FrickMsgPackValue]) and Android (rows: StateFlow<Map>), non-nil value upserts / nil deletes / re-subscribe on reconnect. No wire/protocol/generated changes. Tests: Swift 104 total 0 failures (6 new), Android FrickProjectionStoreTest 4 tests green. Contract doc updated.
